en.headline: Alibaba prices HK$80 billion Hong Kong share placement to fund AI expansion
en.dek: The company is issuing 710 million new shares at HK$112.70 each, marking the largest primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed firm, with proceeds earmarked for full-stack AI capabilities.
body: Alibaba Group on Monday confirmed the pricing of a HK$80 billion placing of 710 million newly issued ordinary shares at HK$112.70 each, with the deal expected to close on 26 August subject to customary conditions.

The company said it intends to use 100 per cent of the net proceeds to invest in its full-stack artificial-intelligence capabilities, including expanding and enhancing AI infrastructure. The placement ranks as the largest-ever primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed company and the third-largest globally this year after deals by Alphabet and Intel.

Shares of the dual-listed e-commerce and cloud group fell about 8 per cent in early Hong Kong trade after the announcement. The offer price represented an 8.4 per cent discount to the previous Hong Kong close.

zh.headline: 阿里巴巴港股配售800億港元新股 全部用於AI發展
zh.dek: 公司按每股112.70港元發行7.1億股新股，為港股歷來最大型一次主要後續發售，所得款項全數投入全棧人工智能能力。
body: 阿里巴巴集團周一確認以每股112.70港元配售7.1億股新發行普通股，集資800億港元，預計8月26日完成交易，惟須符合慣常條件。
公司表示，所得款項淨額100%將用於投資全棧人工智能能力，包括擴充及提升AI基礎設施。是次配售為港股上市公司歷來最大型一次主要後續發售，亦是今年全球第三大，僅次於Alphabet及Intel的相關交易。
雙重上市的電商及雲端集團股份在港股早段下跌約8%。配售價較上一個港股收市價折讓約8.4%。
